acknowledgeCompanionBridges.description: Acknowledge ordinary-current companion bridges (e.g. expansion-theme). Records acknowledgement and allows safe @use module-source rewrite only; does not rewrite companion calls or approve visuals.

acknowledgeAggregates.description: Acknowledge historical all-legacy-component-themes aggregate membership (incl. ordinary companions). Allows safe @use rewrite only; does not substitute owned-only aggregates.

acknowledgeCurrentComponents.description: Acknowledge ordinary (non-legacy) @angular/material imports for readiness. Does not rewrite those imports or waive parity tests.
